name: What should homeowners do to prepare for kitchen molding installation?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners do to prepare for kitchen molding installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your installer arrives, clear all countertops and remove breakable items from adjacent wall areas. If light rails are being added underneath upper cabinets, unplug small appliances and clear your backsplash workspace. You should also ensure clear walking pathways from the home entry to the kitchen so technicians can bring in miter saws, ladders, and long trim pieces safely. If you are painting or staining the molding on-site, designate a well-ventilated staging space such as a garage or patio.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear countertops, remove upper cabinet contents, keep walking paths open for tools and ladders, and set aside a ventilated staging space for cutting.
